market_question: Will Thomas Massie be the Republican nominee for KY-04?
reasoning: Massie is the long‑time incumbent with a very strong primary track record (75% in 2024). While he has hinted at a possible Senate run in 2026, the baseline expectation for an incumbent is to seek re‑election, and if he runs, his renomination probability is near‑certain. I estimate a ~66% chance he is the House nominee, well above the market‑implied 48.5%.
evidence_points: Won 2024 KY‑04 Republican primary with 75.2% against a well‑funded challenger.
Has held the seat since 2012 and built deep district name recognition and donor networks.
Public speculation about a Senate run introduces some uncertainty, but most House incumbents run for re‑election.
sources_consulted: News reports on potential 2026 Senate race
General knowledge of congressional primary dynamics
